name: RAOfflineProxy
summary: Provides an offline RetroAchievements proxy for supported emulators.

notes: Review on 2026-10-20 verified the Knulli v2.2.0-alpha1 shell asset against the GitHub digest: 1377625 bytes, SHA-256 94d1d2de7d213300463dc6e4f4fd28ce9ba25344e3b2fe9c7371f7b4f9a06f0b. No installer was executed.

Rechecked 2026-10-24: data-only decoding at byte offset 1173 after the unique __RAOFFLINEPROXY_PAYLOAD_BELOW__ marker yielded a 1018930-byte tar.gz with 66 regular files, 9 directories, and 2340621 regular-file bytes. No duplicate paths, traversal, absolute paths, or special-file entries were found. Store base64_offset support removes the need for a separately published archive; it never executes the shell prefix.
The packaged updater downloads a Knulli shell asset without a pinned size or checksum; the menu invokes its installation. These paths must be disabled in a Store-managed package.

Runtime integration writes shared boot and emulator configuration, including /userdata/system/custom.sh. Configured path overrides and hook removal need containment and ownership review. readelf inspection of both bundled native libraries confirms ELF64 AArch64, libc/libpthread dependencies, and a highest GLIBC symbol requirement of 2.17. The SQLite extension targets CPython 3.12; target Python/pygame availability and runtime loading remain unverified. Missing device-test evidence alone will not block a safe package.

evidence.note: Downloaded Knulli shell asset matches the GitHub API size and SHA-256. Embedded archive was read as data only; extraction safety does not establish runtime safety or device compatibility.

Packaged download_knulli_update_installer writes a downloaded executable without an expected checksum. Packaged menu_sdl.py invokes installation; platform.py writes a boot hook and accepts configured startup paths.
